body: PR #2797 rework pushed as a new commit, no force-push. Head b109f6f277. 1) A Refs group now only suppresses an id on the same line: the subject's Refs groups suppress only the subject's ids (new refs_completion_filter in db_reconcile.rs, used by auto-bump and reconcile-status). A body bullet never suppresses the subject's trailer, and a body trailer is skipped only when every body line carrying it names it in a Refs group. 2) New test: '<subject> (BUG-999) (#2800)' with body '* slice (Refs BUG-999)' completes BUG-999 in both auto-bump and reconcile-status; the Refs-subject negative case is kept, and a unit test covers the per-line rule. 3) The test asserts the --subject merge_args gets for a Refs title equals the title. Gates: make check-ci-fast 33/33 passed; make test-touched 288 passed; the 5 bug_2203 tests pass.
subject: PR-2797 rework pushed (BUG-2203)
